cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Supportive Rage
cards.instruction: Remain helpful and encouraging while becoming increasingly furious.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. Choose the birthday lunch you really want. I'll drive.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The seaside place. We'd lose your deposit here.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. Forty pounds wasted. Fine. You love the sea; let's make a day of it.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've booked it. They need another forty now.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Another forty? Eighty pounds before a bloody sandwich. Give me the number. You're getting your sea view. Ask for a window; you deserve one.

cardFidelity.evidence: A1 decides and A3 postpones questions, but A5 ordinary encouragement and payment offer do not sustain the specific approval stance.

responseLogic.evidence: B2 lost deposit causes A3 anger and support; B4 second deposit causes A5 larger fury and action, despite A3 unrelated restriction.

relationship.evidence: B2 warns about cost and B4 supplies the new payment requirement, plausibly pursuing an offered birthday choice.

heightening.evidence: B4 doubles the cost and A5 intensifies anger while helping secure the sea view.

brevityWit.evidence: A5 eighty-before-sandwich complaint is earned by B4 second forty, but A3 prefabricated status wording interrupts it.
